summary.summary_zh: Qwen 团队发布 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B，这是基于预训练 Qwen3.5-4B 视觉语言模型构建的自动驾驶基础模型，在完全不改 VLM 架构的前提下将 3D 感知、视觉问答与运动规划统一在同一框架中。模型外挂两个模块：BEV 感知头（联合执行 3D 目标检测、语义占据预测与 BEV 地图分割）和基于流匹配的 Planning Expert，用于生成未来自车轨迹。分阶段训练配方统一跨数据集标注并结合通用视觉语言数据，在获得驾驶能力的同时缓解灾难性遗忘。同时发布 planner-sft 与 planner-rl 两个规划专家版本，后者在 NAVSIM PDMS、WOD-E2E RFS 及位移项奖励上进一步优化。

innovations.title: VLM架构不变的外挂式统一框架
innovations.detail: 以Qwen3.5-4B为共享VLM且架构完全不变，外挂BEV感知头（联合3D检测、语义占据预测、BEV地图分割）与Planning Expert（基于流匹配生成未来自车轨迹）

innovations.title: 分阶段训练数据配方
innovations.detail: 统一跨数据集标签、改写回复、按一致性过滤样本，并将驾驶数据与通用视觉语言监督结合以缓解灾难性遗忘

innovations.title: 双Planning Expert（SFT/RL）
innovations.detail: planner-sft支持直接规划与推理规划两种模式；planner-rl在NAVSIM PDMS、WOD-E2E RFS和位移项奖励上进一步优化，最适合推理规划模式

summary.progress_note: 为基于Qwen3.5-4B的新领域（自动驾驶）基础模型，号称首个在预训练阶段统一3D感知与视觉问答并扩展至运动规划的VLM，属新方向开拓而非同系列迭代

training.data_mix: A staged training recipe combines driving supervision with general-purpose vision-language data; staged data recipe unifies cross-dataset labels, rewrites responses, filters samples for consistency, and combines driving data with general-purpose vision-language supervision
pretrain_innovations: Unifies 3D perception and visual question answering at the pretraining stage while keeping pretrained VLM architecture untouched
External BEV perception head as explicit inspectable 3D probe (3D detection, semantic occupancy prediction, BEV map segmentation)
Staged training recipe combining driving supervision with general-purpose vision-language data to mitigate catastrophic forgetting
posttrain_innovations: Planning Expert conditioned on shared VLM representations generates future ego trajectories through flow matching
Unified trajectory annotations enable joint training across multiple public driving datasets
Data recipe unifies cross-dataset labels, rewrites responses, filters samples for consistency
planner-rl reward-optimized on NAVSIM PDMS, WOD-E2E RFS and a displacement term
Two released Planning Experts: planner-sft (direct and reasoning planning) and planner-rl (reasoning planning mode)
